basics.name: Shashidhar Ravishankar
basics.label: Director of AI/ML, Athos Therapeutics
basics.summary: I lead AI and machine learning at a clinical-stage biotech company. I build AI tools that help scientists use complex biological data to make better decisions in drug discovery.

work.name: Athos Therapeutics
work.summary: I set the company's AI strategy and lead the AI/ML work of a small engineering team. We are building an agentic AI platform for multi-omic data analysis, together with the drug discovery scientists who use it.

work.name: Fred Hutchinson Cancer Center
work.summary: I built protein language models to predict which targets T-cells recognize, and I studied the immune response to Kaposi sarcoma and other virus-linked cancers. Co-PI on a Yosemite-American Cancer Society Award.

work.name: Fred Hutchinson Cancer Center
work.summary: I built LymphoSeq2, an open-source R package for immune repertoire analysis, and automated pipelines for single-cell and immune repertoire data.

work.name: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, Malaria Branch
work.summary: I built NeST, a sequencing analysis toolkit for tracking malaria drug resistance. It was adopted as a standard protocol across six CDC laboratories.

awards.title: Yosemite-American Cancer Society Award (Co-PI)
awards.summary: Understanding the grammar of T-cell antigen recognition using fine-tuned large language models.

projects.name: LymphoSeq2
projects.summary: Open-source R package for immune repertoire analysis.

projects.name: NeST
projects.summary: Sequencing analysis toolkit for malaria drug resistance surveillance.
